configured_cognition_may_read: task instruction supplied to the agent
task metadata explicitly supplied to the agent
files and command outputs actually present in the built runtime workspace after task environment startup
configured_cognition_must_not_read_befor: tests/** or hidden verifier logic not present in the runtime workspace
build-only benchmark source or Docker build context removed before runtime
repository environment/** source merely because it was used to build the runtime

stage_order.benchmark: CursorBench 4.0 or matched direct behavioral equivalent

acceptable_signals: successful long-horizon completion where baseline fails
verifier-confirmed improvement traceable to configuration-prescribed actions

execution_completion_policy.requirement_traceability: Every validity/rejection requirement must cite authoritative instruction or runtime-visible spec evidence. Inferred identity components cannot become mandatory validation fields without explicit authority.
execution_completion_policy.acceptance_coverage: Every explicit acceptance criterion must have fresh passing evidence before terminal authorization.
execution_completion_policy.ui_rule: If UI/browser behavior is part of acceptance, valid success + invalid rejection + state-preservation behavior must be executed before terminal authorization.
execution_completion_policy.terminal_authority: Public bridge commit ce540975febcd262c94a0f2b025b99180a18e18e or later must enforce BRAIN_SESSION_TERMINAL_AUTHORIZATION_V1 with zero known relevant failures and all acceptance/verification entries PASS.
execution_completion_policy.spent_task_rule: After independent verifier exposure, the task is spent and cannot be repaired/replayed for promotion.
